name: seedsbss-pos-desktop
description: SeedsBSS POS para Windows — shell Electron sobre o ecrã de venda do seedsbss-client.
author: Moxi Group

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: npm run build:main && cross-env SEEDS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:4300 SEEDS_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1 electron .
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:dir: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win --x64 --dir --publish never
scripts.release: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --win --x64 --publish never
